text:
Hello Casey,

I'm Megan Torres, a recruiter with Apex Talent Partners. We're helping our client, Riverside Health, fill a Finance Operations Intern role for summer 2027 in Columbus, OH ($24/hour, hybrid). If it sounds interesting, I can share the full job description and set up a phone screen, followed by interviews with the Riverside team.

Best,
Megan Torres
megan.torres@apextalentpartners.com
